name: Hornings Hideout (Meadow Ridge)

photos.alt: Hornings Hideout (Meadow Ridge) disc golf course

aboutParagraphs: Meadow Ridge is the third and longest course at Horning's Hideout, the private pay-to-play disc golf property in the hills west of Portland. Bob Horning built it as the big brother to the property's other two courses, and from the blue tees it plays 5,540 feet at par 56 through woodsy terrain.

It's a day-trip destination: pay at the gate, play all three courses, camp on the property, and let the whole weekend revolve around discs. The blue tees are the standard loop here, while the gold tees stretch it further for the big arms.
The course rewards clean lines over power — the woods give you a lane and expect you to hit it.

signatureHoleDescription: Hole 16 is the longest at Meadow Ridge at 692 feet, and the hole that gives the course its grown-up reputation. From the blue tees it's a true three-shot par 4 through the woodsy terrain, with the fairway asking for a placed drive before the green comes into view. It's the finishing test of a course built for all-day disc golf.
localTips: Pay at the gate — this is a private, pay-to-play property with three courses, so plan a full day. Camping is available on site, and the whole place is built around disc golf weekends. The blue tees are the standard loop; the gold tees add distance if you want more.
